boundaries.operation: release of the ML-DSA keygen seed
boundaries.before: The seed was adopted with adopt_cleansed and released through CRYPTO_clear_free, i.e. plain free(), although it came from CRYPTO_secure_malloc. Once the secure heap is initialised this releases an arena pointer to the system allocator.
boundaries.after: adopt_secure_cleansed, releasing through CRYPTO_secure_clear_free. With no secure heap that path performs the same cleanse and the same CRYPTO_free with the same size and coordinates, so allocator-hook observability is unchanged.
boundaries.mechanism: ELIMINATED: the release mechanism is now derived from the constructor rather than re-asserted by hand at the erase arm.

divergence.class: UB in the C authority is not reproduced (AGENTS.md section 17)
divergence.authority_behaviour: ml_dsa_key.c:467 frees a secure-arena seed with OPENSSL_clear_free.
divergence.our_behaviour: The erase arm releases through the secure cleansed path.
divergence.compatibility_consequence: With no secure heap, the seam call and its coordinates are identical. With a secure heap, the authority's behaviour is undefined, so there is no defined behaviour to preserve.
divergence.status: ACCEPTED DIVERGENCE, recorded here and in code

controls.observed: free(): invalid pointer; signal 6 SIGABRT; EXIT=101. Restored; git status clean; HEAD unchanged.

Inits the secure heap (1 MiB, 16), allocates the 32-byte seed itself, asserts CRYPTO_secure_allocated(seed)==1, installs it, so seed != NULL skips the RNG arm and keygen_internal must take the erase arm. Post-conditions assert seed == NULL and CRYPTO_secure_used() == 0.
